title: Final secondary speaker requires real-crib A/B evidence
description: The product names CE70PR-4 as a candidate and requires real-crib comparison with SLS-65 before serial BOM selection. A paper choice would not establish acoustic or electrical behavior.

evidence.note: Final speaker choice follows the prescribed physical A/B test.
R3 reviewed this finding; its existing blocker phase and required external/R4 evidence remain open.
R4 preflight reviewed this finding. External physical/acoustic/mechanical closure remains phase-scoped; R4 did not close it.

closure_criterion: Record controlled A/B tests in the actual crib at 80/100/125/160/250/500/800 Hz, including attenuation, THD, excursion, Vrms/Irms and repeatable operating conditions; approve final speaker and load envelope before R13 PASS.
